what: Pika 6-step Sol panel, Pass 1 (2026-11-11), on workflows/h3_text_to_video_pika_api.json (PIKA_FL2VA_SVD995_LORA via MiniMaxH3LoRABranch, 6 steps on lcm with PIKA_MANUAL_SIGMAS, shift_video=12.0, comfy-kitchen 0.2.41+sol.b63d8c7.up.7d6a22a). One prompt-bank scene (t2va_covered_market, 1344x768, 345 frames — patched from the graph's 362 ceiling to match the bank entry's scripted 14.375s duration), one seed (730451892), five arms holding sink_conditioning=exact_kv_and_all_rows, quantizer=rotated, tau=1.0, and token_routing=off fixed: dense (dense_blocks=0-49: all 300 block-calls on comfy-kitchen INT8 dense attention via ModelAttentionBackend, not exact BF16/FP32 SDPA), shipped (start_percent=0.2 -> Step 0 dense, dense_blocks=38-42,49: 80 dense / 220 sparse), s0_b49 (start_percent=0.2 -> Step 0 dense, dense_blocks=49: 55 dense / 245 sparse), s01_b49 (start_percent=0.28 -> Steps 0-1 dense, dense_blocks=49: 104 dense / 196 sparse), and s012_b49 (start_percent=0.55 -> Steps 0-2 dense, dense_blocks=49: 153 dense / 147 sparse).
why: The shipped Sol defaults (start_percent=0.2, dense_blocks=38-42,49) were adopted on PDD8 + FlashGen per-block probes where blocks 38-42 spiked under PDD8/FlashGen distillation, and 2026-10-02_sol_dense_blocks_panel.md showed dense_blocks did not fix broken scripted motion on market. On Pika's 6-step schedule (sigmas 1.0, 0.972973, 0.923077, 0.8, 0.571429, 0.333333 at shift 12), start_percent=0.2 (sigma_start=0.979592) runs only Step 0 dense and switches Steps 1-5 to sparse while coarse motion is still forming. Pass 1 tests whether blocks 38-42 buy anything on Pika (shipped vs s0_b49) and whether shifting the dense budget from mid-stack blocks on late steps to whole early steps (s01_b49 at sigma_start=0.968610, s012_b49 at sigma_start=0.907563) preserves scripted crate/coin motion and two-speaker dialogue against the all-dense INT8 reference.
